meta.name: deepchem
meta.description: Molecular ML with diverse featurizers and pre-built datasets. Use for property prediction (ADMET, toxicity) with traditional ML or GNNs when you want extensive featurization options and MoleculeNet benchmarks. Best for quick experiments with pre-trained models, diverse molecular representations. For graph-first PyTorch workflows use torchdrug; for benchmark datasets use pytdc.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用分子特征预测化合物毒性等性质
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果研究化学或药物,需要预测化合物性质
copy.tagline_en: Predict molecular properties like toxicity from structural data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work in chemistry or pharma and need to predict compound properties

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能帮你加载分子数据(SMILES、SDF、FASTA),把分子转成机器学习特征(指纹、描述符、图表示),并训练模型预测溶解度、毒性等分子性质,还能在 MoleculeNet 基准数据集上训练与评测。
howto.when: 当你需要预测分子性质(如 ADMET、毒性)、把分子转成建模特征,或使用 MoleculeNet 基准数据集时接管。若要做以图为核心的 PyTorch 流程,原文建议改用 torchdrug。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can load molecular data (SMILES, SDF, FASTA), featurize molecules, train models to predict properties like solubility or toxicity, and evaluate them on MoleculeNet benchmarks.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to predict molecular properties (ADMET, toxicity), featurize molecules for ML, or work with MoleculeNet benchmarks. For graph-first PyTorch workflows, the docs point to torchdrug.
